newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Kairinos float to raise 148 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Kairinos float to raise 148 mln rand.

text.p: South Africa's Kairinos Foods Ltd said on Tuesday that its upcoming listing on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) would raise 148 million rand.
The listing will give the firm a market capitalisation of more than 250 million rand at a profit to earnings ratio of less than 10.
The group has more than 180 outlets in South Africa and will list on June 18 in the JSE's Beverages, Hotels And Leisure sector.
The offer is in the form of 20 million shares to the public, a private placing of 98 million shares and a preferential offer of 30 million shares to directors and employers.

Kairinos said its earnings per share for the 12 months to December 31 were forecast at 10.20 cents with a dividend of 5.1 cents. The firm sees earnings of 10.85 cents and a dividend of 5.43 cents for the 12 months to June 1998, the first 12 months after the listing of Kairinos.
The firm is made up of six divisions: Mochachos Chicken Villages, Pizza Den, Mimmos, Ocean Basket, Gino's and Java Coast Coffee.
